read.title: Re: Sample Request – Hydrating Mask Line
read.text:
Dear Ms. Lopez,

Thank you for your interest in our hydrating mask line. We are happy to send you samples of our five best-selling products. They will be shipped by courier this Friday, and you should receive them within five business days.

Please note that these samples are free, but we ask distributors to cover the shipping cost for future sample requests. Our standard lead time for orders is three weeks.

Please find attached our price list for your review.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
qs: 앞으로 샘플을 요청할 때 유통업체가 부담할 것은?

write.task: 해외 바이어가 샘플을 요청했어요. 샘플 발송일과 도착 예상 시점을 알리고, 카탈로그를 첨부했다고 답장해 보세요.
write.en: Reply to a buyer's sample request: say when the samples will ship, when they should arrive, and that you attached the catalog.
write.model:
Dear Mr. Tanaka,

Thank you for your sample request. We will ship three samples of our new sheet masks by courier on Monday, and they should arrive within a week. Please find attached our latest catalog and price list. Our lead time for the first order is about four weeks.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
